ours.title: Current manuscript: native validation and measured full-model cost
ours.evaluation_scope: 548-image converted-label native VisDrone val; validation-selected checkpoints; RTDETRValidator; maxDet 300, confidence 0.001, FP32, no TTA/extra NMS. GFLOPs per image, 2 operations per MAC; complete unfused parameter count. No new model execution in this audit.

bdnet.title: BDNet
bdnet.pretraining: none for BDNet explicitly; same-conditions retraining stated for YOLO11/12/26
bdnet.evaluation_scope: VisDrone2019 validation; source uses YOLO-format mAP50-95, not the separate AI-TODv2 COCO metrics. 640, batch 8, SGD lr .01, 300 epochs, 3-epoch warmup; Ultralytics 8.3.78, PyTorch 2.7.1, RTX3090Ti. Exact annotation conversion, maxDet, model selection and GFLOPs counting convention not supplied. Three uncited YOLO rows are the BDNet authors' retraining under their same experimental conditions, not our measurements.

external_context.caption: Reported VisDrone validation accuracy and model cost at 640 input. Bubble area is proportional to GFLOPs per image. Blue points are reported by the BDNet study, whose authors retrained YOLO11/12/26; green points are reported by the FGHDet study. Our host and Full use the native protocol. Training and evaluation protocols differ. For FGHDet and its YOLOv7 baseline, validation accuracy is from Tables 2/5 and same-architecture 640-input cost from Table 6.
